description:
Leidos Enterprise Civil Division in support of the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) is looking for talent in the Automation Development field to work as a Software Engineer. The Department of Homeland Security (DHS) has a continuing requirement for Homeland Enterprise IT Secure Services & Support (HEITS) for the continued operations and maintenance and evolution of the Homeland Secure Data Network (HSDN) and the Classified Local Area Network (C-LAN).
   
 The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and deploying automation solutions using UiPath software. They will analyze business processes, identify opportunities for automation, create workflows, configure robots, and ensure successful implementation. 
   
 Primary Responsibilities: 
 Ensure day-to-day operations of the development and production environments
 Process Analysis & Design - Analyze existing business processes to identify areas where automation can improve efficiency and reduce costs
 Workflow Development - Design and develop automation workflows using UiPath Studio and best practices.
 Robot Configuration - Configure robots (UiPath agents) to run automated tasks.
 Testing & Debugging - Thoroughly test automation solutions to ensure accuracy, reliability, and performance, and troubleshoot any issues that arise
 Implementation & Deployment - Deploy the automated solutions into the production environment and provide support for their ongoing maintenance
 Documentation - Create and maintain documentation for the automation processes, workflows, and solutions
 Collaboration - Collaborate with business analysts, other developers, and stakeholders to ensure successful implementation and ongoing maintenance
   
 Education and Experience: 
 Bachelor’s degree in technology related field with 3 to 5 years of experience developing automation solutions using UiPath or similar robotic process automation platforms. 
   
 Basic Qualifications: 
 Ability to analyze technical and operational processes, designing and developing automation workflows
 Ability to create scripts and integrations, supporting reporting and data-driven automation, connecting with SQL databases, Excel, and other common data sources
 Ability to troubleshoot automation issues and contribute to continuous process improvement
 Strong problem-solving skills, the ability to work independently, and the ability to collaborate with technical teams, operations staff, and occasional government stakeholders in a mission-focused environment
 Candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI clearance and be willing to work onsite approximately 90 percent of the time.
  
   
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Strong development experience in C++, C#, Python, VB, .NET, or related technologies
 UiPath certification
 Experience with process design or process improvement
 Familiarity with SQL, databases, Excel, and other common data storage systems
 Basic networking or infrastructure knowledge, and the ability to identify issues, recommend practical solutions, and deliver reliable automation capabilities in a complex enterprise environment
 DHS EOD
 Security Vetting for up to TS/SCI
 If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.
 
 
 Original Posting: 
November 19, 2026 
 For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above.







 
 
 Pay Range: 
Pay Range $87,100.00 - $157,450.00 
 The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.
